title: Quantization Does Not Undo Abliteration / Substring Refusal Detection Fabricates Safety Effects under Quantization (artifact)
description: Artifact for two ACSAC 2026 workshop papers (ARTMAN 2026 and CSET 2026). Evaluation prompts, judge verdicts for all 46,600 generations (response text replaced by SHA-256), human annotation labels (132 reference labels plus 300 second-annotator labels), checkpoint-differencing and rank-sweep measurements, the judge ablation, the failure-mode decomposition, the language-switch mechanism experiments, and the code that produces every table and figure in both papers. Raw model responses are distributed through a separate restricted record.
